g.text: Average-end-area volumes accumulate into a mass-haul curve with a balance point
Hypothetical intervals: cut end areas0,30,0 m² then fill end areas0,30,0 m², at50 m spacing, giving net volumes +750,+750,−750,−750 m³. Cut and fill meet at zero
area at100 m. Common volume basis assumed, no shrink/swell; equal ordinates indicate balanced net volume, not guaranteed economical haul. Average-end-area is an
